method: Rows are exclusions for shipped assets/processed cells that do NOT reproduce from their assets/processed-full master by scripts/anim-pass-reextract.mjs --verify-downscale. Re-measure with that flag before editing: a row whose cell now reproduces byte-identically is reported STALE EXCLUSION and belongs under retired, never deleted (CLAUDE.md 4.10b).
